Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3470); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.
BiblicalUsage: Isaiah is a person named 22 times in Scripture, in John, Matthew, and Romans. The full story lives on the Isaiah profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Isaiah matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
